acceptance_checks: decide_goal_action accepts condition verdicts as a parameter and performs no file or network I/O, preserving its purity contract.
With every task done and at least one fail verdict, decide_goal_action returns stop_goal_conditions and never goal_complete.
The stop reason names each unmet condition verbatim as it appears in goal.completion_conditions.
stop_goal_conditions is a member of STOP_ACTIONS so goal_loop_step exits non-zero.
Positive control: with every task done and every condition passing, decide_goal_action still returns goal_complete.
The loop never writes, narrows, or reorders goal.completion_conditions on any path.
tests/test_loop_engine.py covers the stop path and the positive control.

scripts/test_shiki_goal_loop.sh proves an end-to-end goal with one done task and an unsatisfiable condition does not reach status complete, using a fixture condition that is NOT satisfiable by task completion alone.
non_goals: Performing any file or network I/O inside decide_goal_action.
Narrowing or editing any goal's completion_conditions.
scope: Resolve condition verdicts read-only in goal_loop_step and pass them into decide_goal_action as a pure parameter. Make all-tasks-done necessary but not sufficient: when a verdict is unmet, emit stop_goal_conditions naming each unmet condition verbatim, and register stop_goal_conditions in STOP_ACTIONS so the loop exits non-zero before building a closeout.
test_command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && python3 scripts/validate_shiki.py --target . && for s in scripts/test_shiki_*.sh; do bash "$s" || exit 1; done
title: Make the loop refuse a closeout for a goal whose completion conditions are unmet
